status: reviewed: drawn by one annotator (Claude Code) by eye, then independently reviewed by a second Claude Code agent on 2026-10-15 (overlays of polygons + saved detection boxes, 2-3x zoom checks, green-rim profiles, pairwise overlap check); not yet reviewed by the user
purpose: Stack-face geometry for the A/B/C counting experiment (arm B needs stack-face polygons). Geometry only: no layer, tray or egg counts are recorded here.
rules: Count labels (handwritten numbers, labels.csv, user reports) were not read or used to place any polygon, depth row or membership decision; label scope text from the audit was used only to say which block is the target.
Coordinates are pixels of the EXIF-transposed (upright) image, which is the frame of the saved detections in every file listed (frame_check per image).
Saved detections were overlaid only to confirm the coordinate frame; polygons were drawn from the pixels, not from the boxes.

fields.id: polygon id, unique within the image
fields.polygon: [[x, y], ...] in upright image pixels, simple polygon, first vertex not repeated
fields.role: target (the block the label or scan refers to) | neighbour (stack outside the target block)
fields.depth_row: 0 = front row facing the camera, 1 = one stack depth behind, 2+ further; for neighbours a rough distance rank
fields.top_visible: the stack's top tray is in frame and not hidden
fields.base_visible: the bottom tray is in frame and not hidden
fields.clipped: none | top | bottom | side | combinations (cut by the frame edge)
fields.blurred: defocus or motion blur strong enough to merge tray rows, by eye (see sharpness_lapvar)
fields.contents_note: filled | empty cover on top | nested empties | mixed | unknown (descriptive only)
fields.occluded: what hides part of the face, if anything
fields.face_view: front | side | oblique_top | top | oblique_side | unknown (which face of the stack the polygon covers)
fields.physical_stack_inferred: key of the physical stack (block:cell or photo:name), for linking views; inferred, not verified
fields.membership_uncertain: true when target vs neighbour (or the depth row) is a judgement call
fields.sharpness_lapvar: variance of the 3x3 Laplacian inside the polygon at native resolution (measured; comparable only within one photo)
fields.review_overlap_px: per image: rasterised pixel overlap between polygon pairs after review (shared boundaries rasterise into both polygons, so ~1 px x edge length remains by construction)
fields.review: per image: reviewer's change log and confidence (geometry / membership)
